description: Generate a brand new share link for a Lite server (by id or exact name), or create its first one. The old link stops working the moment this succeeds, so anyone it was already sent to loses access until they are given the new one. Requires `confirm: true`; tell the user exactly that before setting it.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be regenerated (the old share link stops working immediately and everyone it was sent to loses access) and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: regenerate_jit_share_url
title: Regenerate Share Link
